scope: Pre-execution independent static/code/generated-proof and authorized NEW source geometry review. No RGB rendering, model, feature, weight, current223, V112 or PnP access/execution by this review.

registration_and_geometry_checks.registration: NEW constructive assets have identity mesh-to-canonical transform, fixed saved YAW0 permutation and literal canonical native8 anchors on their declared primary local parts. This confirms this NEW asset registration; it does not establish identity to legacy CAD or real weak source cues.
independent_geometry_only_checks: All 8 anchors are literal vertices of their declared primary part.
All 296 witnesses lie in the declared primary-part bounds and on at least one incident surface plane.
Saved proper CV camera rotation and principal point [127.5,127.5] agree.
All target/foreign camera depths are positive and above near .001.
COVER and SHAM share the same cuboid shape/orientation/depth; SHAM is one fixed translation, not a replacement object.

renderer_alignment.camera: Exact saved K/R/t, literal design camera_eye, original 256 canvas; integer pixel centres 0..255, c127.5. CPU V93 projection; no OpenGL phase bridge.
renderer_alignment.geometry: Exact mesh and foreign 12-triangle cuboid; all declared box surfaces opaque double-sided/orientation +1, no hidden assumption of legacy single-sided surfaces.
renderer_alignment.raster: Pinned V93 near clipping, top-left edge convention, perspective reciprocal-depth interpolation and final-global-min 64-ULP different-owner tie eligibility; ambiguity flag/tie_count retained independently of deterministic owner.
renderer_alignment.namespace: Target local part owners 0..N-1; foreign owner 999; background -1. Global triangle IDs target 0..F-1 and foreign F..F+11 remain separate from owner IDs.
renderer_alignment.reuse: Target per-part depth/face layers rendered once per style, saved and digest checked before/after each variant; real foreign layer resolved jointly. Same unchanged owner/face/depth surface RGB asserted bit-exact.
renderer_alignment.appearance: Fixed procedural world-position material and Lambert/sRGB shading; part-ID colors confined to separate display-only images.
renderer_alignment.guards: Root entry required before mesh loading; exact policy/code/proof/source hashes; existing output refused, failed attempt preserved, automatic retries false. No crops or learning admission created.

teacher_alignment.D: Target alone has at least two front-facing incident faces and every active finite witness is direct on the expected registered part; combined active witnesses remain D.
teacher_alignment.E: Only originally-D regions qualify; every original active witness first hits foreign owner 999 before its target reference.
teacher_alignment.S: All 37 target-alone witnesses are blocked by the same target assembly, including same-part front surfaces; separate from external E.
teacher_alignment.U: Mixed/partial/competing ownership, ties, misses, off-frame or insufficient face visibility remain U.

resolved_preexecution_issue.issue: Certain nearest-pixel background owner/depth can disagree with a continuous witness hit; the original depth summary could emit NaN and fail strict JSON serialization.
resolved_preexecution_issue.final_resolution: Final f8279820 retains all certain-owner disagreements and explicit background/nonfinite counts; depth extrema use finite-depth-only comparable mask and serialize null if empty. No owner discrepancy is dropped and no source labels change.
resolved_preexecution_issue.evidence: Final generated proof includes an invented all-background 37-witness fixture with 37 owner disagreements, 0 finite-depth pairs and null maximum; json.dumps(...,allow_nan=False) succeeds.

limitations: The 37-ray finite structural-region convention is not an exhaustive continuous-area visibility proof or a finite-RGB-pixel cue certificate.

The selected native1 support spans only about 1.9-2.5 pixels per axis at 256 resolution; 37 witnesses reduce to 7/8 rounded sample pixels. Aliasing and owner/depth differences between distinct rays must be reported, not used to coerce teacher labels.
This is pre-render source geometry/code scope. Actual saved buffers and RGB readability remain uninspected here and must not be claimed as verified.
Procedural photometric realism, real external-visibility transfer, legacy asset identity, human native gold and training admission are not established.
D/S/E/U are registered structural endpoint-region states, not centre-material membership, whole-part visibility or coordinate-correctness verification.
